items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I went over to Utica, and heard a kid in a d'Amico club, and I immediately hired him. It was Hank Damico.

ctx.x: And so one weekend, we had to work five days there, and I went over to Utica, and heard a kid in a d'Amico club, and I immediately hired him. It was Hank Damico.
